slots.hypothesis: Event tails in intraday trade timing, not its average level. c = day_centroid(in_slice(Volume, 1, 236)), the continuous-session volume centroid, measured on each stock's own 50/100-day distribution. Measures: moment skew ts_skew; a tail-mean robust skew ((T75-M)-(M-T25))/(T75-T25) built from cross_tail_mean_q75/q25 and cross_med, in the MAX(N) spirit; and one-sided tail depths over cross_stddev, with prior signs late tail -1 (closing/passive execution pressure that reverts) and early tail +1 (overnight information absorbed at the open). Also an Amt version, a 100-day window, a full-day control, a Pearson back-loadedness version and ts_kurt. Three conditioned versions bucket by the centroid level (orthogonal to head +1.28), by the known family, and by the frozen-quote ratio (against limit-lock days). Evidence: in r2 R, cross_ema@10 -> cross_med@20 lost 0.38, and both M3 heads are ts_skew(.,50) of other inner quantities. 13 seeds.

Call-auction participation share as investor-mix information, not liquidity level. o = day_first(Volume)/day_sum(Volume) is the opening-auction share and k = day_sum(in_slice(Volume,237,240))/day_sum(Volume) is the closing-auction share; both are degree-0 in volume. Seeds: levels (20-day mean, 60-day median), o-k and log(close/open auction volume), 20-minus-120-day changes (these let the 2018-08-20 SSE closing-auction reform heal), the +1.13 slow-mean-vs-lagged-mean structure applied to o (nets out general volume growth), and buckets by frozen-quote ratio, known family and liquidity. ListAge and cross_valid_count are deliberately not used as keys (large tie blocks, trap 4-2). Prior sign is -1 for k, from head +1.28 losing 0.34 when the closing window is removed; the sign of o is decided by whether it matches k. 14 seeds.
